verdict.rationale: Unleash documents a gradual rollout strategy that releases to a small subset of users and percentage-based rollouts (e.g., 75% of users). Activation strategies change exposure without redeploying, and release management supports milestone progression (e.g., 25% to 50%) via templates and automation. missing for 10: explicit evidence of consistent/sticky bucketing (stickiness/hashing so users stay in their cohort), explicit documentation of fine-grained ramping from 1%, independent or hands-on corroboration.
